question: Once a lifecycle is attached (min-dwell k=2), does STATE v2 survive a STRICT single-split blind test, an ablation ladder, 4-block stability, and does MTF context add incremental value?

carried.phase1: frozen label is memoryless (churn 0.6292@M15, duration median 1 bar); no lifecycle constraint
carried.phase2: T1 frozen DeltaLL=0.19786 (p=0.0); T2 stateful k=2 DeltaLL=0.27661 (p=0.0); geometry fails floor; event fails majority

state_v2_definition: STATE_V2(t) = frozen MARKET_BEHAVIOR with minimum dwell k=2 (a new label is only accepted after it persists >= 2 consecutive bars; otherwise the previous accepted label carries forward). k=2 pre-registered from Phase 1 (not tuned here).

protocol.blind_split: single split at 60% of bars; model fit ONCE on first 60%, evaluated ONCE on last 40% (no refit, no peeking)
protocol.model: multinomial logistic, C=1.0, lbfgs, TRAIN-only StandardScaler
protocol.stability: 4 equal sub-blocks of the blind test region; require all DeltaLL > 0
protocol.mtf_increment: add H1 context (h1_ret, h1_rng, h1_slope, causal ffill) to A3; MTF_ADDS_VALUE if delta DeltaLL >= floor
protocol.acceptance: best blind variant has DeltaLL >= floor AND beats majority accuracy AND all 4 stability blocks positive
